overview.text: Kaggle hosts competitions for submitted agent systems, illustrated by the Gemma 4 Developer Agent event. Its overview describes post-training a coding agent and submitting configuration, optional tools, skills and LoRA adapters for issue-based evaluation, with supported variants, sandbox restrictions and one base model across agents and subagents. Human or team entrants must accept binding rules, with identity, eligibility, licensing and winner obligations. Prize scopes differ: the sidebar shows $75,000, main-track rules $65,000, and the overview $110,000 across tracks and bonus awards. These are not interchangeable payouts. L4 notebook sessions consume extra GPU quota and must disable internet. Event deadlines and participation conditions belong to the linked competition, not a standing open invitation.
